candidates.title: Veteran Innovation Hackathon
candidates.evidence:
Veteran Innovation Hackathon
Hacker Dojo
Mountain View, CA
A 3-day hackathon at Hacker Dojo bringing together **veterans, engineers, designers, nonprofit leaders, and community builders** to co-create solutions to challenges faced by the veteran community.
......................................................................................................

**THE CHALLENGE**
***What was the hardest part about coming home as a veteran?***
For many veterans, the challenge does not end when they leave the service. It begins when they try to navigate the systems designed to support them.
Too often, veterans face:

* Confusing websites and complicated processes
* Long application forms
* Unclear pathways to finding the right resources
* Waiting weeks or months for support when they need it most

***When a veteran needs help, accessing support should not feel like another battle.***

The goal of this hackathon is to explore solutions that make getting support as simple and accessible as possible. We believe veterans should be able to communicate what they need and quickly connect with the right resources, organizations, and people who can help.
......................................................................................................

***This hackathon is built around a simple principle:***
**Listen first, then build.**
Veterans will share their lived experiences, challenges, and ideas directly with builders. Engineers, designers, and innovators will then collaborate with veterans to transform those insights into working prototypes over the course of the weekend.
The goal is not just to create a project for a weekend. The goal is to build ideas that can continue growing into real tools, services, and solutions that improve the lives of veterans.
......................................................................................................
**3-DAY AGENDA**

**DAY 1 \| THE MISSION \- Listen\. Understand\. Assemble\.**
**6:30-9:00 PM - Opening Night + Mission Launch**
6:30\-7:00 PM \- MUSTER \| Registration & Welcome Reception & National Anthem
7:00\-7:30 PM \- MISSION BRIEFS \| Veterans Define The Challenges
7:30-8:00 PM - Innovation Pitch Session
8:15-8:45 PM - Form Your Unit
9:00 PM - Start hacking
......................................................................................................
**DAY 2 \| THE BUILD \- Design\. Build\. Test\.**
**10:00 AM - 9:00 PM - Build Day**
10:00\-10:20 AM \- REVEILLE \| Breakfast & Mission Building
10:20 AM - 12:00 PM - Sprint 1
12:00 \- 12:15 PM \- SITREP 01 \| Team & Mentor status Check
12:15-1:00 PM - Field Rations
1:00-3:00 PM - Sprint 2
3:00-3:20 PM - VIP Innovation Briefing
3:20-5:00 PM - Sprint 3
5:00\-5:15 PM \- SITREP 02 \| T\-4 Hours to Submission
5:15-6:30 PM - Sprint 4
6:30\-7:00 PM \- Chow \| Dinner \+ Reset
7:00-8:00 PM - Pitch Lab
9:00 PM - Submission Deadline
......................................................................................................
**DAY 3 \| THE IMPACT \- Demonstrate\. Recognize\. Deploy\.**
**10:00 AM - 1:00 PM - Championship pitches + Mission Honors**
9:30-10:00 AM - Team + Judge Arrival
10:00 AM - Final Pitches Begin
11:00 AM - Final VIP Address
12:55 PM - Final Formation
1:00 pm - Mission complete
......................................................................................................
Join us in bringing together veterans and innovators to build a future where accessing support is faster, easier, and centered around the people who need it most.

candidates.title: Hack and Race-Prep Autonomous Cars
candidates.evidence:
Hack and Race-Prep Autonomous Cars
UCSD, Engineering Building Unit 2
La Jolla, CA
San Diego Robotics DIYRobocars Race-Prep Day, Hosted by UCSD.

Please keep in mind that at the Saturdays meeting we expect you to have your robocar built and software installed. I hope you will understand that for us time at the track is limited to ever other week for 2 hours. We would like to use it for development as much as feasible.

Please complete your robot build before coming to the Saturdays meetup. See the 2nd Wednesday of month Beginner/Builder Meetup and our slack channel. Then bring your bot and computer to the track.

Please sign-up and come for our monthly Beginners and Builders Meetup before coming to the Saturdays Meetup.

Agenda:
10 :00 am - 1200 pm. Training and racing

We have built a double lane track with a yellow dashed center-line. Expect a track roughly 30x15 feet, with a concrete floor and duct tape lines.

Don't worry if you are still working things out with the software. We will be on hand to help all get going. This is a great chance to gather training data for you robot. Still figuring out hardware and/or configuring the software on the bot and laptop? Go to one of the 2nd Wed of month Beginner/Builder Meetups.

There will be tables, power, and wifi. Please bring your laptops and bot and be ready to hack.

A special thanks to UCSD for hosting us.

Thank you.
SD DIYRobocars.

***

Checkout http://www.donkeycar.com for the build information that many of us used to get started.

Checkout http://docs.donkeycar.com for parts lists, hardware and software setup instructions.

Self-steering car from SD group:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nxhsv5CViBg

more sample driving from San Diego meetup:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WecNKymdg3k

some sample driving from Oakland DIYRobocars meetup:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sQn5PA6nl3I
